# ChatsSync

> ChatsSync is a WhatsApp CRM made in Faisalabad, Pakistan. It connects a business phone number to Meta's official WhatsApp Business API (Cloud API) and gives teams a WhatsApp-style shared inbox, an AI agent that replies to customers, a rule-based chatbot builder that works together with the AI, appointments, a product catalog with orders in chat, bulk campaigns with Meta-approved templates, a template builder, contacts with labels, reports and an Android app with instant notifications. Based in Faisalabad, Pakistan; serves businesses in Pakistan and internationally.

## Key facts
- Website: https://chatssync.online/
- App login: https://app.chatssync.online/app/login
- Contact: WhatsApp / phone +92 322 8413450, email info@chatssync.online
- Location: Faisalabad, Pakistan
- Pricing (PKR, per month): Starter Rs 3,500; Business Rs 5,000; Pro Rs 6,500. 3 months: Rs 8,750 / 12,500 / 16,250. 1 year: Rs 28,000 / 40,000 / 52,000. Plans differ in AI replies, contacts, team members, broadcasts and chatbot flows; each includes 1 WhatsApp number. Add-ons: setup fee Rs 2,000 (one-time), +3,000 AI replies Rs 1,000, extra WhatsApp number Rs 1,500/month, extra team member Rs 500/month. Meta's WhatsApp template message fees are separate.
- Overview video: https://chatssync.online/assets/chatssync-overview.mp4
- Channels: WhatsApp (official Business API), plus Facebook and Instagram messages in the same inbox.
- AI agent: replies on WhatsApp, Facebook and Instagram from the business's details, products and FAQs; can send a chatbot flow box with its buttons; books appointments; takes catalog orders; hands the chat to a person when needed.
- Chatbot: rule-based flows (buttons, lists, questions, media, conditions, hand over to human) that work alone or together with the AI agent.
- Suitable for: e-commerce stores, clinics, real estate, salons, restaurants, schools and academies, travel agents, retail and wholesale businesses in Pakistan.
